title: Rome · Abruzzo Gran Sasso High Road
slogan: A 263 km loop out of L’Aquila
story: Big empty plateau roads above Rome. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 105 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Campo Imperatore, Gran Sasso view road, Santo Stefano di Sessanio, while L’Aquila fuel gate and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

title: Rome · Tuscany Val d’Orcia Sweep

This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 146 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Pienza ridge roads, Val d’Orcia cypress road, while the fuel checkpoint and Orvieto coffee gate keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Val d Orcia Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 26 km this is Val d Orcia Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
